normal.coordinates: Center longitude 0 and x increasing eastward in the GeoTIFF. Roll the 180 E left edge by half a width into 0–360 E; no mirror. USGS labels use west longitude.

enhanced.coordinates: 0 E left edge, north up. Trailing hemisphere fractures align near 90 E with the rolled monochrome mosaic.
enhanced.processing: Published radiometric calibration, geographic registration and photometric correction by Paul Schenk. Preserve intrinsic hemisphere differences, source seams and residual photographed shading.

elevation.sourceUnits: Global grids contain radius from the center in meters; regional products have a different convention and are not used.
elevation.resolution: Approximately 1.58 km; 2222 × 679 equator and 444 × 444 for each pole.
elevation.accuracy: Producer estimates typical global DTM uncertainty at 1.58–3.17 km, worse where source imagery is coarser.
elevation.processing: Sample original equatorial and polar geotransforms. Bilinear interpolation only inside measured grids; northwest relief at true height scale. No invented gap filling.

shape.rendering: Mean-radius sphere from the astronomy package; terrain changes the image only. Distinct measurement and cartographic reference radii remain explicit.
